gitCommit.subject: Benchmark: restore upstream's workflow files in the working tree before the tests
gitCommit.body:
Benchmark: restore upstream's workflow files in the working tree before the tests

Some e2e scenarios read .github/workflows (static-checks.yml and others), which this
copy deletes so nothing runs on its own. A step puts the deleted files back from the
upstream-tree commit on every runner; they are not committed, so they stay inactive.

specs.title: recovers from an expired bearer during app bootstrap without redirect looping
rejects fresh protected submissions for each configured source
honors omitted and explicit message filter selector defaults
withholds inapplicable actions while a generation streams
keeps a triggered action visible once the pointer leaves the row
keeps the whole toolbar visible while one action is open
shows the queued follow-up as the next user turn the moment the run completes @scenario:queued-follow-up-shows-as-the-next-turn
merges a quoted excerpt into the model turn, pins it to the message, and persists across reload @scenario:quoted-excerpt-reaches-the-model-and-persists
summons the popup from a native double-click word selection
summons the popup from a triple-click on the reply's closing paragraph
still refuses a selection that really spans two messages
keeps the popup pinned to the selection while the chat scrolls
hides the popup when a selection inside a table scrolls out of the chat
hides the popup when a table is scrolled sideways past the selection
hides the popup when the selection collapses without a mouse event
stages each selection as its own chip in the tray, and removes one @scenario:staged-quotes-show-as-chips-and-remove-one
removes a staged quote via keyboard
re-merges a persisted quote into later-turn history (durable)
summons the popup from a mouse-less touch selection and adds it by tap
carries a touch-selected excerpt through to the model
adds nothing when a press on the popup is dragged away and released
dismisses the popup when a cancelled press took the selection with it
never shows a popup for a selection scrolled away during the settle wait
survives the scroll a phone fires while selecting
isolates two overlapping runs of the same parent and child agents
